lines.text: Posted Readout · Nov 10 · test_1 · v1: Scale: Recommend scale because cost per result is $2.40 vs target $4.00 (0.6x target) which is <= 0.85x target ($3.40) and results are 42 which is >=30.

Last week Ad 1 showed fatigue with click rate down 61.7% since day 1 at frequency 7.1 [ev-d7-ad_1-ctr] and 3-day cost of $8.70 per trial well above the $4 target [ev-d7-ad_1-cpr3]. Test 1 finished 7 days at 0.6 times target cost with 42 results on $100.94 spend at $2.40 per trial below the $4.00 target [ev-d7-test_1-readout]. Items to act on grew from 1 on day 3 to 3 on day 7 while no watches were flagged.

Last week Test 1 stayed an overdue scale candidate all week, ending Nov 17 at $2.31 per result vs target $4.00 (0.578x target) with 87 results over 14 days [ev-d14-test_1-readout]. Daily headlines showed 1 to 2 items "to act on" each day from Nov 11 to Nov 17 but no changes were proposed [ev-d8-test_1-readout, ev-d14-test_1-readout]. Week 1 had closed with Test 1 at $2.40 and 42 results recommended to scale [ev-d7-test_1-readout], and that efficiency held through Week 2.
